pages.text: $(thing)Physical Damage Types$() describe the nature of the damage that can be dealt by players and mobs. There are three types: $(bold)Piercing$(), $(bold)Slashing$(), and $(bold)Crushing$(). Some entities are able to resist certain damage types, making it difficult or impossible to kill them with certain methods.

$(thing)Piercing$() damage is dealt by pointy weapons such as $(thing)Knives$(), projectiles like $(thing)Arrows$() and $(thing)Javelins$(), fanged monsters like $(thing)Spiders$(), and $(thing)Cacti$(). $(thing)Skeletons$() are invulnerable to piercing damage, and $(thing)Zombies$() are slightly vulnerable to it.
pages.title: §l관통

pages.text: $(thing)참격$() 피해는 $(thing)도끼$()나 $(thing)검$()과 같이 길고 날카로운 무기들과, 곰이나 퓨마같은 대형 $(l:the_world/wild_animals#predators)포식자$()들로부터 발생합니다. $(thing)크리퍼$()는 참격 피해에 취약합니다.
pages.title: §l참격

pages.text: $(thing)충격$() 피해는 $(thing)망치$()나 $(thing)철퇴$() 등의 둔기로부터 발생합니다. $(thing)좀비$() 또한 충격 피해를 주며, 또한 충격 피해에 저항성이 있습니다. $(thing)크리퍼$() 역시 충격 피해에 저항성이 있습니다$(). $(thing)스켈레톤$()은 충격 피해에 취약합니다.
pages.title: 분쇄
Armor
pages.text: $(thing)Armor$() has its own set of damage resistances. These resistances scale with the quality of armor, but may differ among armors of the same tier. Among bronzes, $(thing)Bismuth Bronze$() armor is best at resisting $(thing)Crushing$(), $(thing)Black Bronze$() is best at resisting $(thing)Piercing$() and regular $(thing)Bronze$() does moderately well with any damage.
$(thing)6티어$() 금속에서는, $(thing)청강$()은 $(thing)충격$() 피해 저항성이 크며, $(thing)적강$()은 $(thing)관통$() 피해 저항성이 큽니다.
